_comment: Audio devices and levels. Names may be 'auto' (whatever is plugged into USB, else the board's own codec), an alias (micfil, c920), any substring of a card name as shown by 'arecord -l' (so a USB mic can be named 'Fifine' without knowing ALSA syntax), or a full ALSA device string like 'plughw:CARD=C920,DEV=0'.
_capture_device: 'auto' takes the webcam's microphone when the camera has one, which is next to the speaker's face rather than soldered to the board. The startup line says what it picked; --mic overrides it.
_micfil_range: Hardware gain on the onboard PDM mic, 0-15, ships at 6. Ignored for other capture devices. Tune with agenttools/mic-check.py: highest value keeping speech peaks under about -6 dBFS.
_gains: Digital gain applied in software. playback_gain matters because mqs has no hardware volume control at all.
